d: Martin learns that he may be the father of Sandy's unborn child and Simon feels responsible for Martin's dilemma because he introduced him to Sandy.

st: Mama's Gonna Buy You a Diamond Ring
d: Simon and Rose decide to make changes in their relationship, leading Eric and Annie to think they are breaking up and Sandy attends Lucy's church social to confront Martin.
Eric and Annie learn that Simon and Rose are living together and Lucy's difficulty counseling a young pregnant woman leads her to doubt her abilities as an associate pastor.

st: The Rat's Out of the Bag
d: When Lucy tells Kevin and Matt that she is going to visit Simon at college, the sceptical guys follow her and learn that the real reason behind her visit is to counsel Sandy about her pregnancy.
Sandy asks Simon to take her to the hospital for what she thinks are labour pains, and she admits that she slept with Martin only to make Simon jealous.
When Sandy's father approaches Eric and Lucy about helping his daughter, they are suspicious of the large amount of money he leaves with them.
Eric gains a new perspective on Sandy's pregnancy when he learns that his own mother was pregnant with him before she and his father were married.
The demands of Simon's school and work keep him from celebrating Thanksgiving with the family and Meredith's sister spreads a rumor that Ruthie is pregnant with Martin's baby.
After discovering Rose may be keeping secrets from him, Simon begins to wonder whether his parents were right to discourage him from marrying her.
The entire family takes part in a living nativity scene at the church and Eric dresses as Santa and helps a convalescent home.
When Martin advises a friend not to write an essay on Martin Luther King Jr., others misunderstand and vandalize his car.
When Sandy goes into labour, Simon wants to go to the hospital to support her, but Rose refuses, prompting Simon to acknowledge that he is not sure he still wants to marry Rose.
When Ruthie gets detention for being late to class, she has a great time with the teacher, who introduces her to the music of Gershwin.
Rose tells Simon she does not want to get married in a church and Kevin organizes a Valentine's Day dinner at the hotel where he and Lucy were engaged.
Lucy secretly goes to see a doctor to find out if she is pregnant and Rose is still angry that Simon neglected to tell her that he slept with Sandy.
Simon thinks Rose still has feelings for her ex-fiance and Ruthie gets a new cell phone, but has no one to call her.
Problems arise when Eric and Annie realise Simon and Rose's wedding falls on the same day as Matt and Sarah's graduation ceremony.
The developing bond between Rose and Annie causes Ruthie and Lucy to become jealous and Sam and David try to get family members to divulge their secrets.
Kevin loses his wedding ring in a most inconvenient manner, Simon and Rose have a serious argument and Annie gets upset.
